title: Lymph-node tumour patch (RESEARCH BENCHMARK ONLY, NOT FOR CLINICAL USE)
status: DRAFT: written from general histopathology criteria, needs pathologist review. Truth thresholds (empty_fraction > 0.10, mean_brightness < 0.45 and > 0.6, mean_saturation > 0.4) were chosen from the pilot's quartiles, not from clinical standards.
state_after_gate: An image is attached. It is a 96 by 96 pixel patch of H&E-stained lymph-node tissue, enlarged four times.
